t: You're on Evelyn Street, a street in the London Borough of Lewisham. It takes its name from John Evelyn, the writer, gardener and diarist. Evelyn was also a landowner, a courtier and a minor government official, and he was a founding Fellow of the Royal Society. He is best known today for his diary. There's little else I can say with certainty about the street itself, but the name is a nice reminder of a man who wrote about his own times and helped start one of Britain's great scientific institutions.
